title: HANZE v2.1.1 event dataset
publication_citation: Paprotny, D., Terefenko, P., and Śledziowski, J. (2024). HANZE v2.1: an improved database of flood impacts in Europe from 1870 to 2020. Earth System Science Data 16, 5145–5170.
source_role: compiled event records and affected administrative regions
access_basis: CSV, bibliography, region dictionary, original GIS archive, paper Appendix A and Table 2
restriction: Source-defined country/regional records can describe one wider flood episode. Administrative polygons are not inundation boundaries.

title: Distribution and cementation characteristics of beachrocks along southern, southwestern and western coast of Sri Lanka
citation: Nayanthara, P.G.N., Dassanayake, A.B.N., Nakashima, K., and Kawasaki, S. (2021). Journal of Sedimentary Environments 6, 93–106. Published online 27 November 2020.
access_basis: Original publisher PDF, Tables 1 and 3; methods p.95 and licence p.104
restriction: GPS horizontal datum not stated. Samples describe sampled material, not uniform properties of every part of an outcrop. No formation age measured.

title: The floods in Greece: the case of Mandra in Attica
citation: Soulios, G., Stournaras, G., Nikas, K., and Mattas, C. (2018). Bulletin of the Geological Society of Greece 52(1), 131–144.
license: Article reuse terms not re-assessed; proposed update is a cited factual paraphrase
access_basis: Indexed original PDF text, printed p.132 introduction
restriction: 14–15 November 2017 is retained as the reported interval. Local 23 versus wider-source 24 fatalities remains unresolved.
